487: /// A [`Service`] that accepts requests based on a [`MethodFilter`] and
488: /// allows chaining additional handlers and services.
489: ///
490: /// # When does `MethodRouter` implement [`Service`]?
491: ///
492: /// Whether or not `MethodRouter` implements [`Service`] depends on the state type it requires.
493: ///
494: /// ```
495: /// use tower::Service;
496: /// use axum::{routing::get, extract::State, body::Body, http::Request};
497: ///
498: /// // this `MethodRouter` doesn't require any state, i.e. the state is `()`,
499: /// let method_router = get(|| async {});
500: /// // and thus it implements `Service`
501: /// assert_service(method_router);
502: ///
503: /// // this requires a `String` and doesn't implement `Service`
504: /// let method_router = get(|_: State<String>| async {});
505: /// // until you provide the `String` with `.with_state(...)`
506: /// let method_router_with_state = method_router.with_state(String::new());
507: /// // and then it implements `Service`
508: /// assert_service(method_router_with_state);
509: ///
510: /// // helper to check that a value implements `Service`
511: /// fn assert_service<S>(service: S)
512: /// where
513: ///     S: Service<Request<Body>>,
514: /// {}
515: /// ```
516: pub struct MethodRouter<S = (), B = Body, E = Infallible> {
517:     get: MethodEndpoint<S, B, E>,
518:     head: MethodEndpoint<S, B, E>,
519:     delete: MethodEndpoint<S, B, E>,
520:     options: MethodEndpoint<S, B, E>,
521:     patch: MethodEndpoint<S, B, E>,
522:     post: MethodEndpoint<S, B, E>,
523:     put: MethodEndpoint<S, B, E>,
524:     trace: MethodEndpoint<S, B, E>,
525:     fallback: Fallback<S, B, E>,
526:     allow_header: AllowHeader,
527: }

529: #[derive(Clone, Debug)]
530: enum AllowHeader {
531:     /// No `Allow` header value has been built-up yet. This is the default state
532:     None,
533:     /// Don't set an `Allow` header. This is used when `any` or `any_service` are called.
534:     Skip,
535:     /// The current value of the `Allow` header.
536:     Bytes(BytesMut),
537: }
538: 
539: impl AllowHeader {
540:     fn merge(self, other: Self) -> Self {
541:         match (self, other) {
542:             (AllowHeader::Skip, _) | (_, AllowHeader::Skip) => AllowHeader::Skip,
543:             (AllowHeader::None, AllowHeader::None) => AllowHeader::None,
544:             (AllowHeader::None, AllowHeader::Bytes(pick)) => AllowHeader::Bytes(pick),
545:             (AllowHeader::Bytes(pick), AllowHeader::None) => AllowHeader::Bytes(pick),
546:             (AllowHeader::Bytes(mut a), AllowHeader::Bytes(b)) => {
547:                 a.extend_from_slice(b",");
548:                 a.extend_from_slice(&b);
549:                 AllowHeader::Bytes(a)
550:             }
551:         }
552:     }
553: }

1070:     pub(crate) fn call_with_state(&mut self, req: Request<B>, state: S) -> RouteFuture<B, E> {
1071:         macro_rules! call {
1072:             (
1073:                 $req:expr,
1074:                 $method:expr,
1075:                 $method_variant:ident,
1076:                 $svc:expr
1077:             ) => {
1078:                 if $method == Method::$method_variant {
1079:                     match $svc {
1080:                         MethodEndpoint::None => {}
1081:                         MethodEndpoint::Route(route) => {
1082:                             return RouteFuture::from_future(route.oneshot_inner($req))
1083:                                 .strip_body($method == Method::HEAD);
1084:                         }
1085:                         MethodEndpoint::BoxedHandler(handler) => {
1086:                             let mut route = handler.clone().into_route(state);
1087:                             return RouteFuture::from_future(route.oneshot_inner($req))
1088:                                 .strip_body($method == Method::HEAD);
1089:                         }
1090:                     }
1091:                 }
1092:             };
1093:         }
1094: 
1095:         let method = req.method().clone();
1096: 
1097:         // written with a pattern match like this to ensure we call all routes
1098:         let Self {
1099:             get,
1100:             head,
1101:             delete,
1102:             options,
1103:             patch,
1104:             post,
1105:             put,
1106:             trace,
1107:             fallback,
1108:             allow_header,
1109:         } = self;
1110: 
1111:         call!(req, method, HEAD, head);
1112:         call!(req, method, HEAD, get);
1113:         call!(req, method, GET, get);
1114:         call!(req, method, POST, post);
1115:         call!(req, method, OPTIONS, options);
1116:         call!(req, method, PATCH, patch);
1117:         call!(req, method, PUT, put);
1118:         call!(req, method, DELETE, delete);
1119:         call!(req, method, TRACE, trace);
1120: 
1121:         let future = match fallback {
1122:             Fallback::Default(route) | Fallback::Service(route) => {
1123:                 RouteFuture::from_future(route.oneshot_inner(req))
1124:             }
1125:             Fallback::BoxedHandler(handler) => {
1126:                 let mut route = handler.clone().into_route(state);
1127:                 RouteFuture::from_future(route.oneshot_inner(req))
1128:             }
1129:         };
1130: 
1131:         match allow_header {
1132:             AllowHeader::None => future.allow_header(Bytes::new()),
1133:             AllowHeader::Skip => future,
1134:             AllowHeader::Bytes(allow_header) => future.allow_header(allow_header.clone().freeze()),

1152:                 #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
1153:                 panic!("`allow_header` contained invalid uft-8. This should never happen")
1154:             }
1155:         }
1156:     }
1157: }

The fix is implemented and validated. Summary of changes (mirroring upstream axum PR #1730):

- **axum/src/routing/route.rs:231** — added `InfallibleRouteFuture<B>`, a pinned wrapper around `RouteFuture<B, Infallible>` that always yields a `Response` (infallible error is unconditionally unreachable via `match err {}`).
- **axum/src/routing/future.rs:3** — re-exported `InfallibleRouteFuture` from the future types module.
- **axum/src/routing/method_routing.rs:1278** — implemented `Handler<(), S, B>` for `MethodRouter<S, B>` (any state type `S: Clone + 'static`), delegating to `call_with_state`. This lets a `MethodRouter` that still requires state be passed directly to `Router::fallback` / `MethodRouter::fallback_service`, with the state supplied later via `Router::with_state`.
- **axum/CHANGELOG.md** — noted the fix under Unreleased.
